What is the full form of RVR & JC Colleg: RVR & JC College of Engineering stands for Rayapati Venkata Rangarao & Jagarlamudi Chandramouli College of Engineering, named after its founders and reflecting its legacy of excellence in engineering education.
Where is RVR & JC College located: RVR & JC College of Engineering is located in Chowdavaram, Guntur, Andhra Pradesh, India, in the western suburban region of Guntur City. The postal address is RVR & JC College of Engineering, Chowdavaram, Guntur - 522019, Andhra Pradesh. It’s easily accessible from Guntur City, ideal for students and visitors.
What is the size of RVR & JC College: The RVR & JC College of Engineering campus spans 37.41 acres, featuring a networked infrastructure with academic blocks, hostels for approximately 1250 male and 400 female students, a central library, computer centers, seminar halls, an open-air theater, sports facilities, canteens, and green spaces, creating a vibrant learning environment.
What are the blocks in RVR & JC College: The academic blocks at RVR & JC College include HiTech Block, Digital Block, Cyber Block, Main Block, Decennial Block, and Silver Jubilee Block. The men’s hostel comprises Block-I (123 rooms, ~520 students) and Block-II (151 rooms, ~730 students), while the women’s hostel has 68 rooms accommodating ~400 students, ensuring comfortable living spaces.
Who is the principal of RVR & JC College: The principal of RVR & JC College of Engineering is Dr. K. Ravindra, a visionary leader driving academic excellence and innovation.
What is the staff strength at RVR & JC C: RVR & JC College employs over 360 faculty members, with most holding M.Tech degrees and many with Ph.D.s, ensuring high-quality education. Each subject typically has at least three faculty per class. The college also has dedicated support staff for laboratories, workshops, and administration, fostering a robust academic ecosystem.
What are the timings for students at RVR: For B.Tech students: 1st and 3rd years attend from 10:00 AM to 5:00 PM, while 2nd and 4th years attend from 8:00 AM to 3:00 PM. MCA and MBA programs run from 8:00 AM to 3:00 PM. These timings support a balanced schedule for academic and extracurricular activities.
What is the transportation availability: RVR & JC College operates a fleet of 28 buses connecting Guntur City and Chilakaluripet to the campus in Chowdavaram. The service is optional, highly subsidized, with fares around ₹11-13 per one-way trip from Guntur. Routes cover key areas for student convenience. For detailed schedules or inquiries, contact Dr. K. Praveen Kumar, Transport Committee Coordinator, at 9849652027.
What is the history of RVR & JC College: RVR & JC College of Engineering, established in 1985 by the Nagarjuna Education Society, was founded by Rayapati Venkata Ranga Rao and Jagarlamudi Chandramouli. Starting with four undergraduate branches, it now offers 12 undergraduate and 7 postgraduate programs. Located in Chowdavaram, Guntur, Andhra Pradesh, it is affiliated with Acharya Nagarjuna University, autonomous since 2010, accredited by NAAC with an 'A' grade, and recognized by UGC under Section 2(f) and 12(B). It consistently ranks among India’s top engineering colleges by NIRF, appealing to alumni and prospective students.
What are the undergraduate programs offe: RVR & JC College offers 12 undergraduate B.Tech programs: Computer Science and Engineering (CSE), CSE (Data Science), CSE (Business Systems), CSE (AI & ML), CSE (Cyber Security), Electronics and Communication Engineering (ECE), Electrical and Electronics Engineering (EEE), Mechanical Engineering, Civil Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Information Technology (IT), and Aeronautical Engineering. These programs cater to diverse career aspirations of prospective students.
What are the postgraduate programs offer: The college provides 7 postgraduate programs: M.Tech in Structural Engineering, Computer Science and Engineering, Power Systems, Communication Systems, Machine Design, and MCA (Master of Computer Applications) and MBA (Master of Business Administration), designed for students seeking advanced technical and managerial skills.
What is the admission process for RVR &: Admissions to B.Tech programs are primarily through the Andhra Pradesh EAMCET, with 70% of seats filled via state counseling and 30% under management quota. M.Tech, MCA, and MBA admissions are based on AP PGECET/ICET or management quota. The last date for admissions is typically June 30 each year. Prospective students can visit https://rvrjcce.ac.in/ for application details or contact the admissions office at 0863-2288201.
What is the fee structure for B.Tech pro: The annual tuition fee for B.Tech programs is approximately ₹85,000-₹1,00,000, varying by branch. Additional fees for hostel (~₹40,000/year) and transportation (~₹10,000/year) may apply. Management quota seats have higher fees. Scholarships are available for eligible students. Contact the accounts office for exact details, addressing prospective students and parents.
What are the placement opportunities at: RVR & JC College has a stellar placement record, with 932 students placed in 2025, achieving a highest package of ₹25 LPA and an average of ₹6 LPA. Top recruiters include TCS, Infosys, Wipro, and Cognizant. The placement cell offers training in coding, soft skills, and interviews, ensuring career readiness for students.
What are the hostel facilities at RVR &: The college provides separate hostels for male (1250 students) and female (400 students) students, with modern amenities like Wi-Fi, 24/7 security, mess facilities, and recreational areas. Rooms are shared (2-4 students), and annual hostel fees are around ₹40,000, reassuring parents and supporting current students.
What extracurricular activities are avai: RVR & JC offers vibrant extracurriculars, including sports (cricket, football, badminton, basketball), cultural fests (Tech Fest, Annual Day), and clubs (robotics, coding, music, drama). The college’s cricket team won the 2024 AP Championship. These activities enrich campus life for current students and attract prospective ones.
What scholarships are available at RVR &: Scholarships include merit-based awards for top EAMCET rankers, need-based financial aid, and state government schemes for SC/ST/OBC students. Approximately 30% of students benefit annually, reducing financial burdens for prospective students and parents. Contact the scholarship office for eligibility details.

What are the hostel facilities at RVR &: RVR & JC College provides separate hostel facilities for boys and girls, accommodating nearly 1250 boys and 650 girls across all years. The boys' hostel, NES Mens Hostel, is located adjacent to the college campus at Chandramoulipuram, Chowdavaram, Guntur-522019, with two blocks: Block-I (123 rooms, 520 students) and Block-II (151 rooms, 730 students). The girls' hostel, NES Womens Hostel, is located in Guntur city, approximately 10 km from the campus, with 68 rooms (400 students) and an additional facility accommodating 250 students. Each girls' hostel room houses eight students with two attached bathrooms. Hostel fees are approximately INR 43,000 per year for both hostels, payable via Demand Draft (DD) to 'Nagarjuna Education Society Hostels - Men's Hostel Receipts A/c' for boys and 'NES Womens Hostel' for girls, both at Union Bank, Guntur. Bus transportation for girls from Guntur to the college costs INR 18,000 annually (2024-25), payable to RVRJCCE. Hostel timings include a daily schedule with breakfast (7:30-8:30 AM), lunch (12:30-2:00 PM), snacks with tea/milk (4:00-5:00 PM), and dinner (7:30-9:00 PM). Food types include vegetarian meals with milk/coffee at breakfast, tea/milk at snacks, and a variety of South Indian and North Indian dishes. Facilities include computer centers, reading rooms, TV rooms, indoor games (chess, carrom), gym, volleyball and shuttle courts, dispensary with free medicines, mineral water plant, solar hot water, and 24/7 security with CCTV and biometric monitoring. Strict discipline is enforced, with rules prohibiting electronic appliances (e.g., heaters), requiring biometric entry/exit, and mandating adherence to mess and hostel schedules. Hostel committees, headed by conveners (Dr. B. Varaprasad Rao for boys, contact: 0863-2244116; girls' hostel office: 0863-2238171), oversee operations.
